facts.fact: An RCMRD report for Eswatini's National Disaster Management Agency (CTCN-funded) says crop monitoring pilots combining drones and Sentinel-2 imagery were run at four sites in April 2021, and a satellite-based maize yield model was applied nationally for 2020.
facts.system: NDMA UAV and satellite crop monitoring pilot
